assessments.reasoning: The pinned Index SCOPE.md license criterion applies to the identifiable version 2.1 copyright and patent grants, including an edition retained for historical lookup.

The opensource.org license API returns self-linked record 484, type license, slug osl-2-1 and title Open Software License 2.1. The operative notice specifies version 2.1 before the section 1 grant. The captured JSON digest matches the claimed revision. The successor-link discrepancy concerns another instrument.

Rosen’s September 2021 OSI-list correspondence expressly covers pre-3.0 OSL, which includes 2.1. He described the negotiations leading to 3.0 and requested removal of the earlier forms. Smith’s proposed superseded category accommodated legacy uses. This is evidence for the author’s treatment.

limitations: The CMS supersession note names Open Software License 3.0 but links to nposl-3-0. An exact successor relationship cannot be resolved from that link.
The CMS reports approved=false, a null approval date and no minutes URL. Rosen recalled historical board approval of earlier versions collectively. Edition-specific approval remains unresolved here.
